brief: A sturdy, open mechanical shredding apparatus dominates the canvas. Above it, a stack of books is positioned, ready to fall into the mechanism below. The gears and plates are actively engaged, turning with constant, grinding motion. As books descend, they are torn apart, ejecting fine dust, thick plumes of shredded pulp, and sharp splinters of wood and paper. Steam visibly vents from the friction points, and scorch marks and dark residue accumulate on the metal surfaces. The flying splinters occasionally embed themselves into the remaining books stacked above the shredder.

statement: This sketch depicts a mechanical shredding apparatus in motion, capturing the violent destruction of paper through the grinding action of rotating gears. The composition focuses on the interaction between the static machinery and the falling books that are torn apart by the mechanism. As books descend into the shredder, they disintegrate into fine particles and sharp splinters that fly outward. Steam vents from the friction points of the gears, while dark residue accumulates on the metal surfaces. The viewer observes a continuous mechanical process where material is transformed from solid objects into fragmented debris through the relentless grinding motion of the rotating gears.
